The geometry of the door frames and the glass panes within them shows slight warping. The lines are not perfectly straight, and the thickness of the door frames varies inconsistently, suggesting minor structural instability in the generation.
The hardware on the leftmost door is indistinct and malformed. It lacks a clear handle or lock mechanism, appearing as a vague protrusion rather than a functional object.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'painterly' texture of the walls. While artistic style can mimic decay, AI often fails to render the sharp, chaotic edges of real peeling paint. Also, scrutinize the door hardware; AI frequently struggles with small, complex mechanical objects like locks and handles, often leaving them undefined or fused into the door surface.
